Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/leptonica && grep -RIn "uaf\|free.*pixAverageRasterScans\|numaDestroy(&nas)\|numaCrossingsByThreshold\|numaSelectCrossingThreshold" src/readbarcode.c src/*.c | head -50 && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"prog/fuzzing/barcode_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":8,"var":"data,size","code":"pixs = pixReadMemSpix(data, size);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are parsed as a Leptonica SPIX image; only inputs that decode to a valid 8 bpp image continue."},
{"step":2,"file":"src/readbarcode.c","function":"pixProcessBarcodes","line":138,"var":"pixs","code":"sad = pixProcessBarcodes(pixs, L_BF_ANY, L_USE_WIDTHS, &saw1, 1);","note":"The decoded image is handed to the barcode pipeline, which converts or clones it to an 8 bpp working image."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/readbarcode.c","function":"pixExtractBarcodes","line":170,"var":"pixg","code":"boxa = pixLocateBarcodes(pixs, 20, &pixb, &pixm);","note":"Barcode localization runs edge filtering and connected-component analysis on the attacker-controlled image to isolate candidate barcode regions."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/readbarcode.c","function":"pixReadBarcodes","line":205,"var":"pixt","code":"na = pixReadBarcodeWidths(pixt, method, debugflag);","note":"Each candidate barcode is deskewed/cropped and then analyzed for bar widths, preserving the attacker-controlled pixel pattern into the decoder path."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/readbarcode.c","function":"pixReadBarcodeWidths","line":236,"var":"method","code":"na = pixExtractBarcodeWidths1(pixs, 120, 0.25, NULL, NULL, debugflag);","note":"The widths-based decoder is selected, which computes transition locations from raster scans of the barcode image."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/readbarcode.c","function":"pixExtractBarcodeWidths1","line":645,"var":"nac","code":"nac = pixExtractBarcodeCrossings(pixs, thresh, debugflag);","note":"Crossing locations are derived from the image and then converted into bar widths; this is the data that later drives the vulnerable scan averaging logic."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/readbarcode.c","function":"pixExtractBarcodeCrossings","line":732,"var":"nas","code":"nas = pixAverageRasterScans(pixs, 51);","note":"The function averages horizontal raster scans over the image before interpolation and threshold selection."},
{"step":8,"file":"src/readbarcode.c","function":"pixAverageRasterScans","line":792,"var":"nscans","code":"if (nscans <= h) { first = 0; last = h - 1; nscans = h; }","note":"When the image height is at least the requested scan count, the code overwrites nscans with h but still uses the original nscans divisor later."},
{"step":9,"file":"src/readbarcode.c","function":"pixAverageRasterScans","line":804,"var":"array[j]","code":"array[j] = array[j] / (l_float32)nscans;","note":"The loop divides by the stale scan count instead of the updated height, producing an incorrect average and corrupting the signal fed into crossing detection; this is the root cause in the vulnerable path."},
{"step":10,"file":"src/readbarcode.c","function":"pixExtractBarcodeCrossings","line":744,"var":"nax,nay","code":"numaInterpolateEqxInterval(..., &nax, &nay);","note":"The corrupted raster average is interpolated into a denser signal, propagating the bad values into threshold selection and crossing extraction."},
{"step":11,"file":"src/readbarcode.c","function":"pixExtractBarcodeCrossings","line":756,"var":"nad","code":"nad = numaCrossingsByThreshold(nax, nay, bestthresh);","note":"Crossings are computed from the malformed signal, which can drive downstream width quantization into an invalid state and trigger the sanitizer-reported memory-safety failure."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p)
PY
